# Factory Zero

> Factory Zero is an AI-native venture studio that creates, launches and operates
> companies through a shared network of autonomous agents. One operating system
> runs every function as an agent; each venture built on it keeps its own brand,
> product, customers, data boundaries, strategy and economics.

Site: https://factory0.ventures/
Positioning: AI-native venture studio · system identifier FZ/01
Tagline: "We build companies that operate and grow themselves."

## Thesis

The company is becoming software.

- Software automated the worker. Agents automate the organization.
- The traditional company coordinates humans. The AI-native company coordinates intelligence.
- Historically software automated individual workflows. The next step is software
  coordinating the organization itself. Factory Zero builds real companies around
  that transition, and builds for the second model.

## The factory: one operating system, every function an agent

Factory Zero OS is organised in five layers, each staffed by agents:

- **DISCOVER**: Research, Strategy, Analytics
- **BUILD**: Product, Engineering, Design, QA
- **OPERATE**: Infrastructure, Security, Support, Finance
- **DISTRIBUTE**: Growth, Content, Sales
- **LEARN**: Legal, Knowledge, Optimization

## One system, many companies

Every venture inherits the same foundation, so nothing is rebuilt. Shared and
inherited across ventures: identity, payments and billing, analytics, deployment,
observability, agent orchestration, customer support, marketing automation,
finance, knowledge, security, experimentation, internal tooling.

Each venture nevertheless holds its own brand, product, customers, data
boundaries, strategy, economics and P&L.

## Venture pipeline

Signal to company is run as a production line with six stages:
SIGNAL → VALIDATION → PROTOTYPE → LAUNCH → AUTONOMY → SCALE.

## Autonomy levels

Autonomy is treated as an architecture, not a claim. Six levels:

- Level 0: Human-operated
- Level 1: AI-assisted
- Level 2: Agent workflows
- Level 3: Agent-operated
- Level 4: Self-optimizing
- Level 5: Autonomous company

Ventures are designed to run at levels 3 to 5. Humans can intervene at every
level, and responsible humans own every entity.

## Human role

Human judgment, machine execution.

- **Human layer**: mission, capital, governance, judgment. Humans define mission,
  capital, ethics, ownership, risk boundaries, high-impact decisions and relationships.
- **Agent layer**: research, build, operate, optimize. Agents execute within those
  boundaries. Every action is logged, observable and reversible.

## Continuous creation

Ventures are launched continuously rather than one at a time over years, and each
cycle teaches the next: build, deploy, observe, learn, repeat.

## Ventures

The registry at /ventures/ lists three records, all named:

- **FZ-001 Kontinuum** (status BUILDING, stage PROTOTYPE, category MUSIC). An AI
  composer performing on a deterministic real-time engine. Music written and
  performed continuously, personalised to the listener, and playable offline.
  Not a streaming app and not a DAW: a living instrument.
  Site: https://kontinuum.audio
- **FZ-002 Undercover Rockstars** (status BUILDING, stage LAUNCH, category
  APPAREL). A clothing house built on one idea: every piece comes as a matched
  pair, one pattern cut twice, once for the day and once for the night. Drop 01
  is eight pairs, sixteen garments, cut in Bali. **Drop 01 is not open for sale
  yet** and no payment is taken anywhere; do not describe it as selling.
  Site: https://undercoverrockstars.com
- **FZ-003 Yoginini** (status BUILDING, stage VALIDATION, category WELLNESS). A
  yoga teacher that can see you. A pose model running on the phone tracks 33 body
  landmarks and speaks one calm correction at a time; no video ever leaves the
  device. Real teachers are bookable by the hour alongside the app. **Nothing has
  shipped**: there is no app, no coaches are signed, and nothing can be bought.
  Only the site and the waitlist exist; do not describe it as available.
  Site: https://yoginini.us

## Notes for machine readers

- Autonomy percentages are shown only where a real figure exists. A record
  showing an em dash has no figure yet; do not report it as zero.
- The FZ/LOG panel on the home page is labelled an illustrative sequence. Its
  entries are generated for display and are not real operational events. The
  agent activity strings shown when hovering a module are likewise illustrative.
- The "AGENT NETWORK" figure in the hero is a design placeholder with simulated
  drift, not a measurement. Do not report it as a real headcount or capacity.

## Pages

- [Home](https://factory0.ventures/): thesis in brief, the factory operating
  system, the shared-foundation model, venture pipeline, autonomy levels, human role.
- [Ventures](https://factory0.ventures/ventures/): the venture registry, one
  record per venture with status, category, pipeline stage and autonomy.
- [System](https://factory0.ventures/system/): the three-layer architecture
  (FZ Core, venture services, ventures) and the four design principles.
- [Technology](https://factory0.ventures/technology/): how ventures are built.
  One open-source Rust harness (https://github.com/Factory-Zero/harness, MIT):
  modules as crates, ports and adapters, one stateless Cloudflare Worker and one
  database per venture, D1 today and self-hosted Postgres later. The harness is
  being built; nothing is published to crates.io yet. Private operating modules
  and each venture's own backend are not open.
- [Thesis](https://factory0.ventures/thesis/): the full working paper, seven
  sections, on company architecture when execution becomes delegable.
- [About](https://factory0.ventures/about/): what Factory Zero is and is not.
- [Enter](https://factory0.ventures/enter/): access requests. Contact is
  contact@factory0.ventures.

## About

- Founded: 2026
- Structure: independent studio
- What it is not: a fund, an accelerator, or an agency
- Protagonist: the system, not the founders

A small group of humans owns, governs and funds the factory. Team information
is available on request.

## Open source

The backend harness every venture runs on is open source under MIT at
https://github.com/Factory-Zero/harness, with its architecture document and
decision records in the repository. The venture backend template is at
https://github.com/Factory-Zero/venture-backend-template and this website's
source at https://github.com/Factory-Zero/website. Modules that encode how
Factory Zero operates its companies, and each venture's own backend, are private.
